description: Couverture 4G mobile aucun opérateur - Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.api.isogeo.com. Geographic areas without 4G mobile coverage (none of the four operators) in Normandy. The data does not fall within the scope of the Inspire Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "4G mobile coverage no operator - Normandy" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include développement numérique, données ouvertes, réseau numérique, numérique, aménagement numérique. The listing shows 2022-07-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
